title: The Push-and-Pull Adventure
intro: This quiz checks what you learned about force, types of forces, and effects of force.

questions.explanation: A force is a push or a pull.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a contact force?
questions.explanation: Frictional force is a contact force because it acts between surfaces that touch. Magnetic, gravitational, and electrostatic forces can act at a distance.

questions.prompt: Which force can act without objects touching each other?
questions.explanation: Magnetic force can act at a distance without the objects touching.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is an effect of force?
choices: Changing the direction of a moving object
Changing the color of an object
Changing the temperature of an object
Changing the material of an object
questions.explanation: One effect of force is changing the direction of a moving object.

questions.prompt: What instrument is used to measure force?
questions.explanation: A spring balance is used to measure force.
